# Understanding proportional hazards models

::: {.callout-tip title="Video lecture"}
David Rocke's Epi 204 lecture
[*Survival Regression with the Cox Model I*](https://dmrocke.ucdavis.edu/Class/EPI204-Spring-2021/EPI204-2021-05-04.mp4)
([slides](https://dmrocke.ucdavis.edu/Class/EPI204-Spring-2021/Lecture10ProportionalHazardsModel.pdf))
builds from Kaplan-Meier and Nelson-Aalen estimates for the `bmt` data
to the Cox proportional hazards model and its partial likelihood
[@rocke2021epi204].
:::

{{< include _subfiles/proportional-hazards-models/_sec-understand-coxph.qmd >}}

# Fitting proportional hazards models to data

::: {.callout-tip title="Video lecture"}
David Rocke's Epi 204 lecture
[*Survival Regression with the Cox Model II*](https://dmrocke.ucdavis.edu/Class/EPI204-Spring-2021/EPI204-2021-05-06.mp4)
([slides](https://dmrocke.ucdavis.edu/Class/EPI204-Spring-2021/Lecture11SurvivalRegression.pdf))
covers partial likelihood estimation,
adjustment for ties,
the `coxph()` function,
inference for hazard ratios,
and predicted survival curves,
using the `bmt` data
[@rocke2021epi204].
:::

# Building Cox Proportional Hazards Models

::: {.callout-tip title="Video lectures"}
David Rocke's two Epi 204 lectures on
*Model Building and Checking for Cox Models*
([part 1](https://dmrocke.ucdavis.edu/Class/EPI204-Spring-2021/EPI204-2021-05-11.mp4),
[part 2](https://dmrocke.ucdavis.edu/Class/EPI204-Spring-2021/EPI204-2021-05-13.mp4);
[slides](https://dmrocke.ucdavis.edu/Class/EPI204-Spring-2021/Lecture12SurvivalAnalysisModelBuilding.pdf))
use the `hodg` lymphoma data to cover
Schoenfeld residuals and `cox.zph()`,
Cox-Snell and martingale residuals,
influence diagnostics,
and stratification
[@rocke2021epi204].
:::
